home.guide.title: How to read an offer
home.guide.upTo.title: “Up to” discounts
home.guide.upTo.body: “Up to 30%” is the highest rate. Your discount may be lower depending on the merchant, item or card.
home.guide.cards.title: Card eligibility
home.guide.cards.body: Offers list the card types and networks the bank names. When a bank does not say, we show it as not specified.
home.guide.dates.title: Validity
home.guide.dates.body: Offers are shown until the end of their last valid day (Sri Lanka time). Check the bank’s page for the latest terms.
nearby.subtitle: Active offers with confirmed branch locations, nearest first, around {place}
nearby.emptyHint: Try a larger radius or another city.
nearby.approxNote: Distances are measured from the confirmed branch address, not the town centre.

offer.areaOnlyNote: The bank gave only an area, not a branch address, so no map pin is shown.
offer.onlineNote: The bank lists this as an online offer. Check the terms for how to claim it.
offer.nationwideNote: The bank lists this as an island-wide offer. It does not confirm which outlets take part, so check the terms.
